decisions.title: Use FastAPI for backend API
decisions.rationale: FastAPI provides typed request/response models, clear API docs generation, and efficient Python backend development.

decisions.title: Maintain shared Engram export snapshots in ops/engram
decisions.rationale: Versioned exports keep team decisions visible in-repo and reduce context loss across sessions.

architecture.title: Hexagonal architecture boundaries
architecture.guideline: Separate domain logic, application services, inbound adapters, and outbound adapters; framework details stay at the edges.

patterns.title: Specs folder structure and templates
patterns.guideline: Use a consistent specs layout with reusable templates for proposal, spec, design, and tasks artifacts.

preferences.title: Documentation and comments
preferences.expectation: Keep documentation and code comments concise, clear, and focused on intent and tradeoffs.

preferences.title: API contracts
preferences.expectation: Keep API contracts explicit and stable, with typed schemas and predictable request/response behavior.

preferences.title: Shared export policy
preferences.expectation: Export only non-sensitive, practical decision context in readable JSON snapshots under ops/engram.
